chat.title: AI Research Assistant
chat.newChatTitle: Start a new conversation (past ones stay reachable via History)
chat.welcomeSub: Describe your question and I'll detect the scene and start a full research run. Try:
suggestions: What structure is BTC perp in right now? Still OK to chase longs?
Is the 10-minute above-60000 event contract worth joining?
What is barbed wire and how do I spot it?
Help me record a BTCUSDT long position
chat.placeholder: Describe your question — research starts automatically…
chat.disclaim: AI output is for reference only and is not investment advice
chat.counterFollowUp: Re-research {{symbol}} ({{horizon}}) from the counter-evidence angle: focus on evidence that does not support the previous conclusion
